questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg valgte University of Toronto da jeg havde obligatoriske fag på KU, som blev udbudt lignende på UofT.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var relativt nemt at finde fag osv inden ankomst, men man kan ikke nødvendigvis regne med at komme ind på fagene, man havde forestillet sig.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ingen. Jeg søgte alle fag inden ankomst.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Der var ingen orientation, men vi var heldigvis mange fra KU, som kunne hjælpe hinanden med fag og andre praktiske ting.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Utrolig svært at finde bolig, Pas på AirBnb's. Vi boede i en lejlighed fra Downtown Suite Living.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Prioriter at bo centralt, offentlig transport om natten er ikke-eksisterende.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Ingen housing for studerende, det er forbeholdt egne studerende fra Canada. Men jeg ville også anbefale at bo off campus så man selv kan lave mad + de studerende on campus er meget unge.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Nem process og de svarer hurtigt på mail.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man blev indstillet af KU og gennem deres portal udfyldte man det step for step, meget nemt og overskueligt.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kunne kontakte exchange office på mail og telefon, de svarede hurtigt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik 3/4 fag, når der ansøges på Google Forms så husk at skrive dine fag fra KU med, da jeg i første runde blev afvist, men fik fag i anden runde pga jeg skrev mine KU-fag på efterfølgende.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Søg mange fag og søg forhåndsgodkendelse hos KU så snart du kan.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Helt fint niveau, større arbejdsmængde i løbet af semestret men det er overskueligt.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg havde to 3. års fag og to 4. års fag.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde meget små hold og der var ingen forelæsninger men kun holdundervisning, så man er meget mere aktiv end på KU.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
African Cultures and Development
Global Environmental Politics
Special Topics in European Affairs: European Union
Topics in Comparative Politics I

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Ingen grund til at søge hårde og svære 4. års fag hvis man er bachelor på KU, arbejdsmængden er meget større og man får samme credit på KU uafhængigt af niveauet.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Inge umiddelbart, men det var dyrere end forventet generelt.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Alt er meget dyrere i Toronto end i Danmark, men kan spise relativt billigt ude, men det løber op hvis man skal have alle måltider ude.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der var club fair for alle foreningerne på UofT og der var rig mulighed for at se og dyrke sport.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Se en masse sport, det er gratis for studerende at se UofT's egne hold.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Se sport, gratis for studerende.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Rejs lidt rundt, der er Flixbus og billige flyafgange hele tiden.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Relativt nemt, folk er åbne og imødekommende, men det hjalp helt sikkert at have mange andre danske studerende også.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Engager dig i klubberne og til sport, ellers mød folk i byen og til undervisning.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Der er meget mere diversitet blandt de studerende og mange studerende holder sig til deres egen kultur, hvilket er uvant for mig som dansk studerende. Meget opdelt efter kultur og etnicitet, svært at trænge igennem som udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Man mødte i undervisning enormt meget diversitet, som gav nogle gode indspark til undervisningen og det sociale.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1) Søg forhåndsgodkendelse i god tid og søg til mange fag
2) Husk det sociale, undervisningen er ikke alt på udveksling
3) Sig ja til alt, tiden flyver afsted

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Insister på at komme ind på fag selvom der er venteliste, professoren kan prioritere dig over andre.
Lav en Facebook-gruppe med alle danskere på fra UofT, York og TMU.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At udvikle sig og møde mange nye mennesker.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At balancere studie og det sociale, man vil gerne opleve det hele, men uni fylder også meget selvom man er på udveksling.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
